title: docs(qa): re-point 21 records-forms checklist items to the v18.5.0 sweep readings
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9LUUQvBoFyjm7sUdButadF7)_

Fixes #33963

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改 `records-forms.json` 一个清单文件，把 v18.5.0 测试轮记下的 26 行文字问题落到 21 个条目上，每个条目 revision +1 并加一行 history。
- 为什么改：测试员按旧文字操作会走错入口、用错数据或误判结果(比如以为某缺陷还没修、以为某条只能挂起)，下一轮测试会重复踩坑。
- 风险与回滚：只是测试清单文字，不动产品代码，不改任何验收判据的结论；回滚就是撤掉这一个提交。
- 先看：`records-forms.json` 里 `gantt-interactions`(只改前两步的操作说明，依赖一半按裁决保持 blocked)、`record-discussion-mentions`(changes_only 一项的原因改写)、`field-unique-enforcement`(复合唯一索引的提示语)。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm check:platform-checklist`，应看到 `check-platform-checklist: OK — 16 areas, 429 items`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Batch A of the v18.5.0 sweep close-out (anchor #33761, ledger comment 6896511848): every item-text re-point row that lands in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json`. Each row was re-read at `origin/main` `895783a1` and the edit starts from the residue measured there, not from the parked text. 26 rows, 21 items; rows 143 and 224 are one edit, as are 141/219/220 (one item, three clauses) and 148/149, 221/222.

Every edited item: `revision` +1 and one `history` row (ref `#PENDING-33963`, swapped for this PR's number in the second commit). The file is not canonical `JSON.stringify` output, so it was edited as text spans by a script that asserts each old span occurs once inside its item, then proves the parsed document equals the old one except in the declared fields of the 21 items (other items and the area-level fixtures value-equal). `coverage.json` was not regenerated: `check:platform-checklist` wrote nothing.

| Ledger row | Item | Clause | What changed (or why not) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 9 | crud-roundtrip | steps[5] | The 1440 px tab row draws a panel tab only for a related panel with records; empty ones wait in the `+N` dropdown, so a fresh account reads `Overview / Activity N` (RecordPageColumns.tsx `partitionRecordTabsByRecords`; QA run #33784). |
| 13 | object-hook-lifecycle | automated.ref | Names `packages/verify/src/harness.hook-refusal-door.test.ts` (exists at the base) as evidence of its own layer. The locale-coverage half is new coverage, left to a checklist-author card. |
| 14 | field-unique-enforcement | acceptance[0] | A declared composite unique index whose fields all carry labels is now named by those labels (#33348, `duplicate_record_fields`); the generic sentence is left for what matches no such index. No step drives a composite, so no verdict moves. |
| 126 | action-preflight-panel | steps[0] | The probe action may sit under the record header's overflow menu once three actions are inline (QA run #33861). |
| 128 | bulk-select-all-matching | knownGaps[1] | "expected FAIL until #28552" retired: the defect closed in d5da45b27 (#28606), and the three `*Capped` strings name the 5000 cap. acceptance[5] never said FAIL; unchanged. |
| 131 | cascading-options | steps[0] | The New form is `.../showcase_cascade/new`; the bare object URL lands on the list. |
| 133 | conditional-rules-header | steps[1], steps[7] | Date input is typed text in the locale format; the invoice form saves through `POST /api/v1/batch` (MasterDetailForm). steps[7] reads paid_on's absence on INV-1004 because steps[1]-[2] leave INV-1002 sent (the same parked note). |
| 135 | encrypted-field-behavior | steps[1] | The field-zoo POST body carries the required `f_master_detail`; said for every POST of the item, so steps[4]'s fail-closed probe reads the crypto refusal, not a validation one. |
| 137 | field-history-tracking | knownGaps[1] | The flag half is driven on a scratch object of the named shape (QA run #33861 did); the code read is the fallback. |
| 140 | form-view-gallery | steps[6] | The record page's Edit opens a `?form=ID` modal, so page routes are reached by URL; a deep-linked page form no longer leaves the document on save (`goBack` replaces to the record or list). |
| 141, 219, 220 | gantt-interactions | steps[0], steps[1] | Switch to Month first (opens at Day on today); grab a bar near its top edge, off the progress handle. Row 219 left as it stands: under the #33351 ruling the dependency half is blocked(fixture) by design, and a runtime overlay onto the notes textarea does not measure a real dependency field. |
| 142 | grid-personalization | steps[1], steps[3] | Density is one cycling button; a runtime group-by lives in the URL (`uf__group`), not in the user's list preference, so a bare-URL reload drops it by design. |
| 143, 224 | home-amount-preview-states | steps[2], fixtures.provisioning.why | The member's recipe invoice needs a line (admin POST) and a currency (member PATCH to USD) before the preview mounts. |
| 144 | kanban-drag-persistence | steps[3] | The client lane gate stops an illegal drop before any request; reaching the server 400 needs a stale board. Both legs recorded. |
| 146 | master-detail-atomic-save | steps[1] | Driver note: fill the trailing blank row; `Add line` beside it submits an all-null line that the batch refuses. |
| 148, 149 | record-discussion-mentions | fixtures.requires[1], steps[0], steps[5], steps[13], knownGaps[3] | Off showcase_task (no discussion surface, no stream on its authored page) onto showcase_project's panel or showcase_account's stream; the interleave is read on the panel or on showcase_field_zoo's stream; the private note is created with its required `title`; changes_only is offered only on a synthesized page, which an authored panel never sits on (RecordDetailView `historyPage`). |
| 150 | related-list-server-pagination | steps[1] | At 1440 px the top-level tab row draws over the columns; a role=tab strip there is expected. |
| 151 | saved-view-management | steps[3] | Unsetting a packaged prior default goes through ensure-customization, then PUT `?package=com.example.showcase.custom`. |
| 153 | setup-recycle-bin-page | steps[0] | Nav label is `Recycle Bin` (setup-nav.contributions.ts); the page title stays `Recycle bin`. |
| 200 | named-import-mapping | acceptance[1] | States the precondition: idempotent with the request's `writeMode` unset; an explicit `writeMode` overrides the mapping's upsert by design (import-prepare.ts). |
| 221, 222 | delete-toast-undo-restore | steps[0], negative[1] | Delete is under the header's More actions menu; the absence of Undo is observable as the `showcase_ops` member that `qa-fixture.mjs contributor-member --position showcase_ops` mints. |

No row was already right at the base and no row moved to another carrier.

## Tests

Docs-only ledger change; no test files touched, none forced. Gates on the final head are listed under Verification.

## Acceptance notes

- **gantt-interactions, row 219:** answered without an edit; the seat read the #33351 ruling as keeping the dependency half blocked(fixture), so QA run #33914's overlay route is not written into the item.
- **record-discussion-mentions, row 149.** At the base the panel offers `changes_only` only from `RecordFieldHistoryContext`, which RecordDetailView fills only for a synthesized page, and a `record:discussion` panel always sits on an authored page, so no fixture can open that leg. acceptance[7].verify still says the leg needs such a panel on a field-history object; it was left as is (it reads blocked(fixture) either way). Whether an unreachable FeedFilterMode value is a product gap is for the seat.
- **conditional-rules-header steps[7]** was not a ledger row of its own; it is the same parked note as row 133 (INV-1002 is sent by then), so it rides the same edit.
- Out of the ledger rows, not edited: related-list-server-pagination steps[1]'s last sentence ("only below 760 px is the page tabbed ... `?tab=related`") was not re-measured by any run; RecordPageColumns' `stack` tier docblock says no tabs. Noted for the next sweep.

## Verification

Final-head gate run, every family `dispatch-gates --commands` derived, each with its exit captured before any pipe; `--ran` reconciliation: 16 derived, 16 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `check:doc-formula-expressions` ran after building `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` under the verify lock (VERDICT command-exit 0).

<details><summary>gates (patch-round head `e13f5b0c`; `a9ca4037` merges origin/main, file unchanged)</summary>

node scripts/check-adr-links.mjs --self-test :: exit 0

`check:platform-checklist`: OK — 16 areas, 429 items (421 active, 3 planned); symbol anchors 1675/1685 resolved, 10 on the named residual.
